activities.assay_description: Binding affinity to dopamine D2 receptor in human brain caudate nucleus

Competitive antagonist activity at D2 long receptor (unknown origin) expressed in CHOK1 cells assessed as inhibition of dopamine induced beta-arrestin recruitment after 90 mins by DiscoveRx PathHunter assay

Competitive antagonist activity at recombinant human D2L receptor expressed in Flp-In CHO cells assessed as inhibition of dopamine-induced reduction in forskolin stimulated cAMP accumulation preincubated for 30 mins followed by forskolin stimulation and measured after 30 mins by BRET assay
